feature_contract.goal: Avoid redundant exclusive file-request locking for already resident replacement DDS textures while preserving cache-miss preload race safety, bounded LRU source lifetime and Win32 game's native fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only FileDataCache::getFileData lock scheduling and targeted source regression verifier; no DDS bytes, formats, scene/HUD scale, FFB, DX11/DXVK or localization changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: getFileData acquires mtx2 before the first LRU lookup despite mtx1 independently protecting all LRU operations and shared_ptr returning a call-scoped owner. The unnecessary serializing acquisition occurs even on hits; no unmeasured FPS gain is claimed.
trace_stages: Original game requests UI/vehicle or stage DDS through D3DX texture-replacement loader.
FileDataCache returns shared-owned source bytes; cache hits use mtx1 alone, misses serialize disk read with mtx2 and recheck after racing preload.
Both fast and native D3D9 texture upload paths retain the same buffer across the D3DX call; resulting graphics are unchanged in XR host composition.
subcomponents: Cache-hit read path bypasses mtx2 but retains LRU mutex and shared_ptr ownership.
Miss path double-checks after taking mtx2, loading exactly once or retaining oversized transient DDS through upload.
Source and destructive mutation verifier plus exact SHA Win32 host/game/package/domain/source impact validation.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A present DDS gets the same shared byte owner and updates LRU with no mtx2 acquisition.
A real miss acquires mtx2, rechecks after waiting, avoids duplicate cacheFile I/O and retains the transient fallback across D3DX.
Source mutation verifier and exact-SHA DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact must all succeed without claiming HMD FPS.

diagnosis.root_cause: Unconditional mtx2 lock was acquired before every cache lookup, serializing shared-owner LRU hits which need only the existing mtx1 protection.
alternatives_rejected: Do not remove mtx1 around cache/LRU publication or return bare evictable data.
Do not eliminate mtx2 on misses: native oversized transient and competing disk loads still require serialization.
Do not change texture formats, mip uploads, sampler state or protected visual content.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Use deferred unique_lock for mtx2, acquire only after first LRU miss, recheck after acquiring and before loading; preserve original call-scoped owner and disk-fallback lifetime.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing cache lifetime verifier extended for hit-before-lock, post-lock double check, oversized transient protection and destructive mutations.
diagnosis.first_failed_gate: OutRun EXE HUD Inspector static analysis #38507105336 found source verifier false negative in post-lock double-check predicate: substring search began inside first `auto owner = ...` occurrence instead of after fileRequestLock.lock(), so valid source was rejected.
diagnosis.retry_repair: Anchor second lookup search after the actual deferred fileRequestLock.lock() call, retaining original three source ownership lookups and all negative mutants. No game C++ changes.

OutRun EXE HUD Inspector CI.dds_verifier: 26 source ownership obligations and 20/20 negative mutations PASS
